name: spec-driven-development
description: Marketplace for the Spec-Driven Development (SDD) plugin and its Claude Code Desktop companion panel.

plugins.name: sdd
plugins.description: Spec-Driven Development framework for Claude Code — canonical SDD flow (spec → clarify → plan → tasks → implement → review), TDD enforcement with contract-first UI, blocking hooks, and orchestration of your existing specialist sub-agents.

plugins.name: sdd-board
plugins.description: Side panel for Claude Code Desktop that shows where each SDD feature stands: current spec with its pipeline phase, next command and tasks, plus an overview of all specs.
